FlowDefinition.description: PacPoint - JB110818 - Created for BREG Phase 1 This flow is launched by a Process Builder on Creation of SEBCaseContact or on change of SEBCaseContact.Account__c or SEBCaseContact.Contact__c. It does the following: 1. Looks up the Account__c and Contact__c field to see which if any is populated. 2. If Contact__c is populated, it will update the name with Contact First and Last Name plus the Role. 3. If Account is populated only, it will update the name with the Role and the Account information.
